title: Minimax Optimal Estimation of Transport-Growth Pairs in Unbalanced Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2605.08705v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Unbalanced optimal transport extends classical optimal transport to measures with different total masses, but statistical guarantees for estimation of the transport map and the growth map remain limited. We study unbalanced optimal transport with quadratic cost and Kullback-Leibler marginal penalties and argue that the natural target of estimation is a transport-growth pair. Consequently, we develop two estimators for the transport-growth pair under two setups: a nearest-neighbor estimator for transporting between general densities, and a kernel-based estimator for transporting between smooth densities. We prove that the kernel-based estimator achieves the minimax optimal rate up to a logarithmic factor by deriving a matching lower bound on the minimax risk. translated_title: 非平衡最优传输中传输-增长对的最小极大最优估计
translated_abstract: 非平衡最优传输将经典最优传输扩展到了总质量不同的测度情形，但针对传输映射和增长映射估计的统计保证仍然有限。我们研究了具有二次代价和库尔巴克-莱布勒（KL）边际惩罚的非平衡最优传输，并论证了估计的自然目标是传输-增长对。因此，我们在两种设定下为传输-增长对开发了两种估计器：一种是在一般密度之间进行传输的最近邻估计器，另一种是在光滑密度之间进行传输的基于核的估计器。我们通过推导最小极大风险的匹配下界，证明了基于核的估计器在对数因子范围内达到了最小极大最优速率。我们的主要技术贡献是将估计问题归约为非平衡最优传输值的稳定性界，该界控制了传输映射和增长映射（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文针对具有二次代价和KL边际惩罚的非平衡最优传输，提出估计传输-增长对的最近邻估计器和基于核的估计器，并证明了核估计器在对数因子内达到最小极大最优速率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes nearest-neighbor and kernel-based estimators for the transport-growth pair in unbalanced optimal transport with quadratic cost and KL marginal penalties, proving the kernel-based estimator achieves the minimax optimal rate up to a logarithmic factor.
